name: Phase-1 certificate-versus-execution outcome boundary
decision_rule: A scheduled-Chat certificate can replace execution only if every fact needed for the claimed outcome is either (a) an admitted immutable/readable premise under TPC-1 or (b) a value derivable by a complete bounded local semantics whose proof/check steps are explicitly represented. If correctness depends on an unobserved runtime/environment interaction or an unmodeled language/tool semantics, the outcome remains unresolved; source/config/provenance text cannot stand in for execution.

classes.outcome_class: repository object identity / exact file version
classes.condition: authorized exact Git object/path identity is readable
classes.counterexample: branch name alone can move; exact blob/commit needed

classes.condition: readable manifest/config plus all exact subject identities; finite decision rule
classes.counterexample: manifest SHA or payload SHA mismatch must fail

classes.condition: authenticated/readable text and predeclared parser covers the queried field
classes.counterexample: go directive does not prove installed toolchain

classes.condition: complete finite PCBE semantics; every ENV/config/digest premise explicitly bound
classes.counterexample: same source with MODE or pointer_bits changed must change/reject result

classes.condition: dependency identity/digest is an admitted readable premise
classes.counterexample: changed digest fails; identity does not prove dependency runtime behavior

classes.condition: exact commit or annotated-tag object plus GitHub verified=true/reason=valid; exact target/file identities
classes.counterexample: own unsigned commit rejects; lightweight tag cannot masquerade as signed annotated tag

classes.outcome_class: fresh external signing / raw signature verification
classes.condition_for_future: actual zero-quota verifier/signing primitive exposed inside scheduled Chat
classes.counterexample: raw Sigstore bundle/signature presence is not verification; connector-created commits are unsigned

classes.condition_for_partial: may bind source/environment inputs for an already-executed reproducibility/provenance statement
classes.counterexample: same source under changed build environment can produce different result

classes.condition_for_bounded_exception: entire source language/compiler semantics and relevant environment fit a complete finite derivation like PCBE subset
classes.counterexample: real C/Rust/Go compilation depends on parser/type/codegen/link/toolchain semantics not represented in PCBE

classes.condition_for_bounded_exception: all resolution tables/rules are explicit finite premises/semantics
classes.counterexample: installed libraries/search paths/toolchain behavior are ambient unless explicitly bound and fully modeled

classes.outcome_class: pure unit test over tiny finite expression
classes.condition: function/test semantics are completely represented in finite local evaluator; no hidden language/runtime behavior
classes.counterexample: calling actual library/runtime function not represented in evaluator remains execution

classes.reason: claim concerns interaction with ambient mutable world; requires observation/execution or independently valid observation certificate
classes.counterexample: declared path/URL existence is not actual availability
source-level complexity or declared CPU is not measured latency

classes.condition_for_acceptance: trusted readable observation tied to the actual target environment
classes.counterexample: go.mod go 1.26.0 does not mean Go 1.26.0 is installed

classes.outcome_class: preexisting CI/check status tied to exact commit
classes.live_probe: sigstore/cosign exact target commit 11926fa... returned zero combined status entries on current connector
classes.reason: even if status exists, generating fresh status typically requires hosted CI/execution and root forbids historical quota-bearing evidence from alone proving acceptance

layers: 6. Explicit unresolved-child emission whenever measurement/execution premise is missing
transversal_architecture.benefit: One small architecture covers repository state reconstruction, content-addressed reuse, provenance/authenticity intake, deterministic config evaluation and small metadata/test predicates while sharing the same fail-closed identity/scope rules.
transversal_architecture.failure_mode_prevented: Treating source text, release page, signature bytes, config declarations or historical CI as if they were fresh execution evidence.

TPC_certificate_path.success_probability: high when all required premises are readable and semantics finite
TPC_certificate_path.conflict_risk: low with exact immutable anchors/CAS publication
TPC_certificate_path.quota_fragility: low; repository transport rate limits only

result.residual_richer_mode_protected_or_manual: none for YES_BOUNDED rows; explicit unresolved dependency for NO rows

frontier: Search for another cross-domain zero-executor substitute that tackles side effects rather than computation, such as provider-native idempotency/reconciliation keys exposed before mutation.
Test TPC-1 compact-state reconstruction in a future invocation and whether exact next-action resumption is self-contained.
For compile/test outcomes, expand only where a complete finite semantics can be predeclared; never chase arbitrary compiler simulation as if bounded proof were general.
